projects.title: Real-Time Fraud Detection API
projects.description: Scores payment transactions as fraudulent in real time via k-nearest-neighbour search over 3 million reference transactions — with no database at all. A pre-built IVF index (2,048 k-means clusters, int8-quantized) is memory-mapped read-only and shared between two Go instances behind nginx, fitting the entire system inside 1 CPU core and 350 MB of RAM. Built for Rinha de Backend 2026.

projects.title: Hikaricon — Geek Event Platform
projects.description: Full-stack platform for discovering and publishing geek events: anime conventions, gaming and tech. Go API behind a Next.js front end, Postgres on Supabase, image uploads to S3-compatible object storage (MinIO locally, S3 in production), fully containerised with Docker.

projects.title: HOI4 Discord Presence
projects.description: Discord Rich Presence for Hearts of Iron IV. Parses Paradox's plaintext save files to surface the player's country, ideology, in-game date and difficulty on their Discord profile, then ships as a one-click Windows installer that flips the game's save format and registers itself with the Paradox launcher. Picked up by players in the wild — 13 stars and 9 forks.

projects.title: Multi-Provider Email Service
projects.description: REST email service in Java 21 and Spring Boot with automatic provider failover: delivery sits behind a provider interface, and the manager falls through from AWS SES to SendGrid when one errors out, so a single provider outage doesn't drop the message. Built as a solution to Uber's public backend coding challenge.

projects.title: Funny Form — Angular Custom Validators
projects.description: Interactive Angular demo of parameterised custom validators built with factory functions in reactive forms. Written as the companion project to a published Dev.to article walking through the pattern.

projects.title: Tower of Hanoi
projects.description: The classic recursion puzzle as a browser game, built in ClojureScript with Reagent and Shadow-cljs — immutable state and a functional approach to UI, compiled to a static site on GitHub Pages.
